verses.text: Tzalajokab' masanil lum lum tik yet' masanil chonhab' t'a stitak ha' mar, yujto a Jehová Rey toni.
Oyanoch k'ik'al asun t'a spatik yichanh. Te tek'an yaj yopisio yujto tojol syutej sch'olb'itani.
Wan sb'at jun k'ak' t'a yichanh, ol tz'ab'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay.
Sakb'i yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj k'ak' tzek' kopnaj yuj, tz'ib'xi lum lum a tz'eq'ui.
Tz'ulaxb'at lum niwak witz icha nok' chaq'uib' t'a yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha satcha'anh sch'oxanel stojolal, haxo heb' chonhab', syil stzikikial heb'.
Ol q'uixwokkan heb' syak'em sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, heb' syik'chaanh sb'a yet' juntzanh yechel chi', yujto masanil juntzanh Dios chi' ol yak'em sb'a t'a yichanh Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, a yab'ixal tas ix utej ak'an syaelal heb' ajk'ool, ol yab' heb' aj Sion yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yuj chi' ol tzalaj heb'.
Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a yib'anh masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ek'al ach t'a yib'anh masanil komon Dios.
Ha ex mach ex tze xajanej Jehová, chakek el chukal. Yujto a heb' sk'anab'ajani, tanhwab'il heb' yuj. Skolji heb' yuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tz'ak'ji sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima wach' spensar yuj, syak'an tzalajk'olal t'a heb' tojol sb'eyb'al.
E masanil ex anima to wach' he pensar, tzalajanhek yuj tas wach' ix sk'ulej Jehová. Alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
